content.rendered:
Each student is invited to attend one Kindergarten Orientation Day. Students will be divided into groups by last name.

Students with last names beginning with letters A-H attend Wednesday, August 30th from 8:00 am-2:15 pm.

Students with last names beginning with letters J-O attend Thursday, August 31st from 8:00 am-2:15 pm.

Students with last names beginning with letters P-Z attend Friday, September 1st from 8:00 am-2:15 pm.

Students will enter through the Activities Entrance which is adjacent to the parking lot starting at 8:00 am.
